import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long power(long x, long e) {
        return power(x, e, 1);
    }

    static long power(long x, long e, long acc) {
        if (e == 0) return acc % MOD;
        long nx = (x * x) % MOD;
        if ((e & 1) == 1) return power(nx, e / 2, (acc * x) % MOD);
        return power(nx, e / 2, acc);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long p = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(power(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(p, p));
            return;
        }

        long current = k;
        long length = 1;
        if (current != 1) {
            do {
                current = (current * k) % p;
                ++length;
            } while (current != 1);
        }

        System.out.println(power(p, (p - 1) / length));
    }
}
